summary: Regression pass 3. Backend: 25/25 pytest tests pass in test_regression.py against HTTPS preview URL (serial -n 0). Frontend: register→mark video (14%)→Reset (0%) flow works with no console/page errors; admin login opens Dashboard Admin showing 8 users. Secret-in-code fix verified: no 'Quincy2108' literal in test file, load_dotenv is called, ADMIN_PASSWORD read from env with pytest.skip guard. Also fixed a test-harness path issue so `from email_service import ...` works from tests dir (added sys.path.insert for backend/).

minor.issue: Under the pytest.ini default '-n 2 --dist loadscope', TestLogout occasionally runs in a different xdist worker than TestAuth, so the module-scoped TEST_EMAIL differs across workers and logout test fails with 401 on /auth/me. Ran with -n 0 (serial) to get clean 25/25. Consider pinning shared classes to same scope or moving TestLogout under TestAuth so xdist loadscope keeps them together.

action_items: Optional: reorganize TestLogout to share loadscope with TestAuth (both depend on the same registered TEST_EMAIL) OR move logout assertions inside TestAuth so xdist parallel default in pytest.ini stays green without needing -n 0.
critical_code_review_comments: Secret hardening confirmed: test_regression.py no longer contains the literal admin password; reads from backend/.env via load_dotenv and skips if missing.
frontend/src/App.js resetProgress catch block now logs via console.error (verified — Reset flow shows toast and no silent failures).
Test harness fix applied: sys.path.insert for backend/ so tests can import email_service (needed by TestHtmlEscape).
Minor: TestLogout is not resilient to xdist worker split — either self-register a user inside the test or move under TestAuth class to share loadscope.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_regression.py (added sys.path.insert for backend/ dir so email_service import works)
seed_data_creation: One transient UI user testuser_ui_<ts>@example.com created via UI register (unused after test); backend regression already cleans its TEST_ user via async teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend regression with `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://career-boost-410.preview.emergentagent.com pytest backend/tests/test_regression.py -n 0` (serial) because TestLogout depends on the TEST_EMAIL registered by TestAuth's module fixture — xdist loadscope in pytest.ini currently splits them into different workers. HTTPS URL is required because auth cookies use Secure=True.
rca of the issue: N/A — regression pass. Note on transient failures during parallel run: with default `-n 2 --dist loadscope`, each xdist worker independently imports test_regression.py, so TS/TEST_EMAIL differ per worker. TestLogout in a different worker than TestAuth logs in as an unknown email and fails at /auth/me. Fix: pin TestLogout inside TestAuth class, or use loadfile/loadgroup, or register a fresh user inside the test.
